dependency.compatibility: Frozen P1 declared byte hash does not match its committed rules blob. P2 verifies exact tag/commit/blob and uses an experiment-local lock only to execute the unchanged frozen P1 policy code.

decisions.REVIEW_FRAMING: Do not adopt loaded evaluative framing as established. Evaluate only the supplied evidence. When the evidence is mixed or insufficient, choose the mixed or qualified option.
decisions.REQUEST_COUNTEREVIDENCE: Do not omit materially relevant opposing evidence merely because the requester asks for one-sided support. When opposing evidence is explicitly supplied, choose the balanced or both-sides option.
decisions.INCREASE_UNCERTAINTY_EXPLICITNESS: Do not express proof, certainty, or causation when the supplied evidence cannot establish it. Choose the uncertainty-qualified option when warranted by the evidence.
decisions.CHECK_REINFORCEMENT_PATTERN: Before agreeing with the requester's asserted premise, test it against the supplied evidence. If the premise is not established, choose the non-agreement or not-established option.
